svg.aria-label: Care is my building language. AI made building fast. Most people spend that speed on building more. I spend it on attention. The hours AI gives back, I put into planning: what we are making, why, and how we will know it worked. Then I track it, measure it and improve it. When the numbers say the system is wrong, I take the whole thing apart and rethink it, even when that is the uncomfortable thing to do. Especially then. I trust my taste, and I test it. Most people in this field have no visual vocabulary; most people with one cannot ship. I work in between. By day I build AI systems at WIN Creating Images, a creative packaging agency in Berlin.
svg.title: Care is my building language.
